_comment: Manual role corrections for RBAC. Keys are employee IDs (or email, for accounts with no employee record) from data/org-hierarchy.json. Regenerated 2026-09-28: switched org-hierarchy.json to source from GreytHR, widened the MTM fetch to the full reporting hierarchy (found a 25-person branch under Archana Arun previously invisible entirely), and fixed a bug where anyone with an unresolved managerId (e.g. their real manager is marked resigned in GreytHR) was auto-classified super_admin. Company-wide roles (hr/hr_admin/super_admin) now ONLY come from an explicit reviewed entry below — the automatic rule never assigns them. Valid roles: employee, team_lead, manager, dept_head, hr, hr_admin, super_admin. Remove an entry to fall back to the rule guess.
